birthday_kids.title: Kids' Birthday Party Planning Flow
birthday_kids.subtitle: Everything you need to plan a memorable celebration in Mumbai

steps.title: The Foundation (4-8 weeks out)
steps.subtitle: Set your core constraints: budget, guest count, and date countdown

steps.title: Venue Selection
steps.subtitle: Choose one of three venue styles tailored for kids in Mumbai

options.name: At Home
options.description: Cheapest and most flexible option. Best for intimate groups (10-25 kids). You handle setup and cleanup, but have total control over schedule and house comfort.
options.pros: Zero hall rent, familiar environment for toddlers, flexible timing
options.cons: Living room wear-and-tear, post-party cleanup effort
options.mumbaiTip: Clear breakables and cushion sharp furniture edges. Book society elevator maintenance in advance if in high-rise.

options.name: Banquet Halls or Lawns
options.tag: Good for Active Kids & Larger Groups
options.description: Ideal for active kids and larger gatherings (30-100+ guests). Gives room for games, stage setup, and buffet spread. Check booking rules early and have a solid rain/heat backup plan.
options.pros: Ample space, dedicated catering area, lawn running room
options.cons: Need to bring in your own sound and decor, booking deposit required
options.mumbaiTip: Recommended verified spots: Bandra Gymkhana Lawn, PTKS Vile Parle, or Juhu/Thane clubhouses.

options.name: Restaurant or Activity Places
options.description: Costs more per child, but takes virtually all the stress and coordination off your plate with dedicated party hosts, built-in soft play or dining, and catering included.
options.pros: Built-in soft play or arcade, private party coordinator, easy parent drop-off
options.cons: Strict 2-hour party windows, higher per-head cost
options.mumbaiTip: Recommended verified spots: Funky Monkeys (Lower Parel/Andheri), Hop N Bop (Khar/Bandra), Smaaash (Lower Parel).

steps.title: Invitations
steps.subtitle: Choose digital or printed invites for your guests

options.name: Digital E-Invite (WhatsApp / Video)
options.desc: Animated motion graphic or elegant PDF card sent straight via WhatsApp with RSVP tracking.

options.name: Custom Printed Cards
options.desc: Themed physical card with custom stickers and envelopes to hand out in school and family.

steps.subtitle: Themed balloon arches, custom photo backdrops, and cake table styling

steps.title: Return Gifts & Favors
steps.subtitle: Thoughtful, educational, and fun favors kids take home

steps.title: Optional: Choose a Party Theme
steps.subtitle: Tie your invitations, cake, and decor together under a cohesive aesthetic

steps.title: Optional Activity Corners
steps.subtitle: Free-flow stations kids can drift between while the main program runs

corners.title: Tattoo Counter
corners.description: Temporary tattoos or face and hand painting. Use skin-safe, non-toxic products and check for allergies.
corners.guidance: Book an experienced artist who uses FDA-approved cosmetic paints and single-use cosmetic sponges. Set up near bright lighting.

corners.title: Games Corner
corners.description: Ring toss, bean bag toss, mini bowling, giant Jenga, board games, or a carnival-style stall with small prizes.
corners.guidance: Have an enthusiastic older sibling or vendor coordinator cheering kids on and handing out sticker or pencil prizes.

corners.title: Build-Your-Own Pastry Corner
corners.description: Cupcake or cookie decorating with frosting, sprinkles, and toppings. Plan one helper per station and have aprons and wipes ready.
corners.guidance: Provide pre-baked plain cupcakes, 3 frosting squeeze bottles (vanilla, chocolate, strawberry), sprinkles, chocolate chips, and wet wipes.

corners.title: Craft Corner
corners.description: Bracelet making, painting, clay modelling, or card making. Gives quieter children a creative outlet away from loud games.
corners.guidance: Lay down plastic newspaper sheets; supply air-dry non-staining clay and bead stringing sets.

corners.title: Photo Booth
corners.description: Props, a backdrop, and a quick instant-print option if budget allows (e.g. Instax/Polaroid or instant photo printer).
corners.guidance: Include fun oversized sunglasses, mustache sticks, superhero masks, and a themed photo frame.

corners.title: Slime or Sand Art Station
corners.description: Messy but very popular with school-age kids. Kids mix colors and take home their custom jar.
corners.guidance: Use non-borax child-safe activator formulas and provide small snap-lid plastic tubs for each kid to carry home safely.

corners.title: Mini Stalls
corners.description: Popcorn or candy floss counter, or a mocktail bar with fun syrups, umbrellas and boba pearls.
corners.guidance: Fresh aroma adds instant party vibe. Operators bring their own machine and extension cords.

corners.title: Treasure or Scavenger Hunt
corners.description: Good for older kids (ages 7-12) and needs minimal setup: hidden scrolls, riddle clues, and a shared treasure box.
corners.guidance: Hide 6-8 rhyming clues around the venue or garden, leading to a locked box filled with foil-wrapped chocolate coins.
